title: Prokaryotic RNA Polymerase, Promoters and Transcription Initiation
method: Unicode lexical count of the 153 teaching-prose paragraphs only, stripping inline citation markers and markup. Article total includes headings, captions, tables, accessible question/answer text, revision, references and visible SVG text labels; excludes SVG metadata and reader UI.
